 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2023-CV-0028
 Marcus Davidson, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
November 26, 2023
Plaintiff's counsel:
Laura Bryant, Dunn & Acosta LLP
PARTIES
Plaintiff Marcus Davidson is an individual residing in Texas who was operating a personal vehicle at the time of the incident
described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to write policies in the State of Texas and doing
business in Pearland, Texas. Defendant may be served through its registered agent in accordance with the Texas Rules of Civil
Procedure.
FACTS
On February 7, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully parked and stationary in a commercial parking lot in Pearland, Texas. While
Plaintiff's vehicle was in that position, a second vehicle insured under a policy issued by Defendant backed out of an adjacent
space and struck the driver's side of Plaintiff's vehicle. The impact was sudden and forceful. Plaintiff reported the collision to
Defendant promptly and provided the information requested, including a description of the damage and the circumstances of the
loss. Plaintiff has since submitted a claim for bodily injury and property damage under the applicable coverage.
NEGLIGENCE
The operator of the insured vehicle owed a duty to exercise ordinary care when backing a vehicle in a parking lot, including
keeping a proper lookout and yielding to vehicles and persons lwafully present. The operator breached that duty by backing into
Plaintiff's vehicle without maintaining a safe lookout or waiting until the path was clear. Defendant, as the insurer of the at-fault
vehicle, is liable for damages within the limits of its policy and is further responsible for handling Plaintiff's claim in good faith
and in compliance with the Texas Insurance Code and the Texas Administrative Code.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a cervical neck strain and a lumbar back strain. Plaintiff has experienced pain,
stiffness, limited range of motion, and difficulty with daily activities, and has incurred medical expenses for evaluation and
treatment. Plaintiff has also lost time from work and experienced physical discomfort and mental anguish. Plaintiff seeks
recovery of economic and non-economic damages in an amount of $44,000.00, tgoether with pre-judgment and post-judgment
interest, court costs, and such other relief to which Plaintiff may be entitled.
